scientific.integrity: The model comparison is equation-level and the short-time mean-square slope follows from Itô's formula. The primary full text and an open-access mean-square-stability reference were inspected directly. The numerical checker only replays exact source-parameter arithmetic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding distinguishes point mean-square stability from stationary concentration. It does not classify invariant distributions or long-time moments of the original stochastic-immigration model. Theorem 4.3 may apply to the altered Section-4 SDE, but not to equations (2.1)–(2.2).

title: The mean-square stability theorem analyzes a different SDE than the stochastic-immigration model
